name: claude-code-action
one_liner: A GitHub bot that lets a team @-mention Claude in a pull request or issue and have it answer questions, review code, or make the fix directly — running inside the team's own GitHub workflow.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small dev team who wants automatic AI code review and quick fixes on every PR without paying for a separate bolt-on SaaS tool.
business_use_cases: A small dev team wires it in so every PR gets an automatic first-pass AI review before a human looks at it.
An open-source maintainer uses it to auto-triage and respond to routine issues, freeing up their own time.
An agency offers 'AI-reviewed pull requests' as a value-add when doing contract development for clients.

money_ideas.idea: Consulting service setting up and tuning it (prompts, permissions, workflows) for a client's specific repo and standards.

steal_this: Set it up on your own repo this weekend, then offer a 1-hour paid 'get AI code review running on your repo' setup session to indie devs.
